sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:66

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:66:1
items.html: The counterpart of AVI are ZA and Rachel, who are equal in their stature; and the counterpart of YESHSUT are Jacob and Rachel the small, from the chest of ZA downward: This has already been explained in the preceding item, that ZA and Rachel, who are equal in their stature, took VAK of MA and VAK of BON, and Jacob and Rachel the small took Malchut of MA and Malchut of BON. See there.
